**Event:** 43rd Motivational Psychology Colloquium\
**Location:** Munich, Germany\
**Authors:** Bakaç, C.

## Context

Social network position is usually explained by structural opportunity or by broad
personality traits. This paper asked whether implicit motives — particularly affiliation
and power — predict where people end up in workplace networks.
